user_reported_bug: numbers are too small when opening the picture with the height markers after using the height measurement tool
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the HOA Measure Heights flow in the real UI with generated 3000x2000 and 800x600 photos. The high-resolution annotated upload retained 3000x2000 dimensions and contained a green height-label component measured at 330x120 px (expected scale=3), while the small-image regression retained baseline ~110x40 px labels; interactive marking and upload both worked.

ui_bugs.issue: A React development overlay appeared once after applying a high-res measurement: 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.' It did not block the measured image generation/upload and appears map/layout-related, not the reported label-size bug.

action_items: Optional: suppress or address the ResizeObserver loop runtime overlay on the add-pole page if it appears for users in preview/dev builds.
critical_code_review_comments: ReferenceHeightMeasurer.createAnnotatedImage now computes s = max(1, max(img.width, img.height)/1000) and applies it to exported annotation fonts, label boxes, line widths, circles, dashes, and title bar. The interactive display canvas remains baseline-sized as intended.
seed_data_creation: Generated local test images only. The UI flow uploaded two temporary annotated images through /api/upload-photo but no pole was saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Latest focused report is iteration_24. High-res upload returned /api/files/poledata/uploads/3eea9b23-236a-41f2-92e7-2657de6322cc.jpg and analysis found a 330x120 green label component. Small upload returned /api/files/poledata/uploads/8781b18c-38ec-4d01-8fee-871587db0785.jpg and analysis found a 110x39 green label component.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior exported canvas used fixed pixel annotation sizes, so labels became visually tiny on high-resolution photos. The fix scales exported annotation dimensions by image size while preserving baseline sizing for images <=1000px.
